content:
arya: Postmortem follow-up: after the weekend incident we should formalize SLO adjustments for the embeddings route. Suggest p95->180ms (was 140ms) and add a throughput SLO: sustained 1200 qps per cluster. This is to reflect new batching & prefetch behavior.

ben: Can you include the measurement window and projected errorbudget impact? We'll need that for the SLA page.

arya: Used 21d window, incident spike pushed p95 to ~300ms and throughput throttled to ~900 qps due to eviction storms. Projected monthly burn if unchanged ~32%; with proposed SLO ~8%.

carmen: Owners? We need someone for rollout, dashboards, alerts, and customer comms.

arya: Proposal: otto (rollout/canary), ben (alerts + runbook), sue (dashboard + SLA note). Timeline: config in 48h, dashboards in 24h, 5d verification. Canary plan 5% -> 30% -> 100% over 36h.

otto: I'll run the canary. Canary checks: embeddings_error_rate, kv_hit_rate, p95/p99. Abort if error_rate > 0.5% or p99 increases >25%.

ben: For alerts prefer a sustained p99 rule to reduce noise. Draft rule:
```
alert: Embeds_P99_Sustained
expr: increase(embeds_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.18"}[5m]) / increase(embeds_requests_total[5m]) < 0.99
for: 7m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "/runbooks/embeds-p99"}
```

sue: I'll add a per-model and per-cluster p99 panel and an errorbudget burn sparkline. Also link incident note. PR by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Incident #2026-310 followups assigned: otto (canary), ben (alerts), sue (dashboards). See /incidents/2026-310/followups.

arya: Also flagging a recurring pattern: similar throughput cliffs every ~6 weeks when long-context evals run. Let's schedule a 2-week hypothesis sprint if the canary stabilizes.

otto: Canary 10% after 4h: p95 170ms, p99 380ms, kv_hit_rate 91%. No abort. Proceeding to 30%.

sue: Dashboard PR: https://git.internal/r/dashboards/pulls/629 — includes per-model panels and runbook links.

ben: Alert PR: https://git.internal/r/alerts/pulls/330 — includes rule tests and silences for short spikes.

otto: 48h checkpoint: p99 steady, errorbudget burn within projection. Rolling to 100% later today.

arya: Great. Sue please draft the customer-facing SLA update language and share with legal. Keep it Dedicated vs Hosted clear.

sue: Draft posted: https://product.internal/sla/embeddings-2026-310 — legal looped in.

ben: Verification plan: daily regression eval + synthetic load for 5 days. I'll post daily short status messages here.

arya: Action recap:
- otto: canary & rollout (due +2 days)
- ben: alerts + verification (due +1 day to land alerts)
- sue: dashboards + SLA note (due +1 day)

Please update thread with progress. :thumbsup:

otto: 24h check: synthetic tests passing, p99 within 5% of baseline. No rollback.

ben: Day 2: daily evals show no quality regressions. Errorbudget burn stable.

arya: Moving to close followups after 5-day verification completes. If recurring 6-week pattern repeats, we open a dedicated sprint. Thanks all.
